messages:
alex_chang: FYI popping up: ~42 nodes in eu-central failing to finish provisioning after the BIOS pin revert we pushed last night. BMCs show repeated 'keystash rollback' messages, nodes cold-booting into netqueue flood. GPU pools reporting <available> capacity.
maria_v: ack. which firmware roll? link to rollout?
alex_chang: rollout tag fw-2026-03-19-biospin. applied canary -> zone -> region. Canary looked fine but region started spiking after ~2h. runbook: https://internal.runbooks/infra/bmc-keystash-recovery
sam_irwin: logs from one host attached (snip):
```
Mar 19 02:14:22 bmc: keystash: state=INVALID, rollback=1
Mar 19 02:14:22 system: bios: secure_pin_revert: true
Mar 19 02:14:23 network: netqueue: tx_queue_len=2048, drop=312
Mar 19 02:14:24 kernel: watchdog: coldboot triggered by bmc_reset
```
jia_chen: netqueue flood looks like BMC firmware invalidating keys, reauth flapping network mgmt plane. that explains provisioning hang and cold reboots.
infra-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-1543 - eu-central provisioning surge. Pager duty alerted.
oncall-svc: pinging oncall, assigning triage. please follow the keystash recovery runbook; prioritize healthy GPU allocation.
maria_v: immediate mitigation proposal: pause rollout, throttle to 1 rack/hour, and mark affected nodes DRAINING from scheduler until we confirm keystash stable. need estimate of capacity impact.
sam_irwin: estimate: 42 nodes ~ 168 A100 equivalents, ~25% of eu-central inference pool. if drain persists >1h we'll hit scheduled-job backpressure; cost to shift load to other regions ~ +18% egress and burst on reserved capacity.
alex_chang: I'm starting automated key restore step (runbook step 5) on 6 nodes to validate. will post outcome.
jia_chen: also seeing several BMCs failing HMAC verify and falling back to rollback image; looks like a signing key mismatch between fw bundle and keystash rotation. Root cause likely stale KMS rotation timing + new BIOS pin flow.
maria_v: if restore fails, plan B: revert BIOS pin toggle on affected rack, then requeue firmware with KMS sync. Need approvals?
oncall-svc: emergency approval granted by infra lead (maria_v). proceed with rack-level revert for racks r-23 and r-24 now.
alex_chang: applied rack revert on r-23. nodes re-provisioning, one came up with GPUs healthy, scheduler shows +12 A100 available. continuing r-24.
sam_irwin: monitoring: netqueue drops down from 2000->120 in r-23, coldboot loop stopped. good sign.
jia_chen: capture for postmortem: verify KMS rotation windows, adjust runbook to include 'keystash signature validation' before region rollout.
maria_v: good. schedule a short maintenance notice for customers in eu-central for next maintenance window; estimate 90m to re-run clean rollout with KMS sync.
alex_chang: double-checking costs: we used burst capacity in us-west to absorb 2h of traffic, estimated incremental cost ~ $4.2k. adding to incident cost summary.
infra-bot: INC-2026-1543 updated: status=mitigated, action=rollback-bios-pin-to-rack, cost_estimate=4200USD, sla_impact=partial degraded for 2h.
maria_v: thank you team. postmortem owners: jia_chen + sam_irwin. we'll prioritize runbook patch and gating checks.
alex_chang: one more note: avoid 'keystash' rename in future bundles; it's causing noise with automated deploy tools.
